Frames

Schema definition and guidance.

Slaughterhouses

Slaughterhouses and Humane Killing

Discourse around slaughtering practices, abattoirs, humane killing, stunning requirements, and conditions in slaughter facilities.

Keywords: slaughterhouse, abattoir, humane killing, stunning, slaughter facility, klanje, abbatoir, matadero, macello, Tierhaltung, stunning requirements

Examples: We demand mandatory stunning in all slaughterhouses.; Improving conditions in abattoirs is a priority.

Cruel Treatments

Cruelty and Inhumane Treatment

Framing of cruelty, abuse, suffering, and inhumane treatment of animals. ONLY assign when cruelty/abuse/suffering is EXPLICITLY mentioned.

Keywords: cruelty, abuse, suffering, inhumane treatment, maltreatment, torture, zlostavljanje, sufrimiento, cruauté, Tierquälerei

Examples: We must end all forms of animal cruelty.; The abuse and suffering of animals must be stopped.

Pet Animals

Pet and Companion Animals

Discourse specifically about pets, companion animals, domestic animals, breeding practices, pet shops, and animal abandonment.

Keywords: pet, companion animal, domestic animal, pet shop, animal abandonment, stray, adoption, breeding, kućni ljubimci, mascotas, animaux de compagnie

Examples: We will regulate pet shops to prevent animal abandonment.; Support for adoption of stray animals.

Cage-Free

Cage-Free and Confinement

Framing around cage-free systems, battery cages, confinement, housing conditions, and freedom of movement for farmed animals.

Keywords: cage-free, battery cage, confinement, housing conditions, freedom of movement, free-range, enriched cages, kavezi, libre de jaulas, stall, box, Tierhaltung

Examples: We support a ban on battery cages for laying hens.; Transition to cage-free systems is a priority.

Plant-Based

Plant-Based Proteins and Diets

Discourse on plant-based alternatives, meat substitutes, reducing animal consumption, vegan/vegetarian options, and protein transition.

Keywords: plant-based, meat substitute, vegan, vegetarian, protein transition, reduce animal consumption, alternative proteins, biljni proteini, alternativas vegetales, ersatzfleisch

Examples: Promote plant-based alternatives to reduce animal suffering.; Support for vegan and vegetarian options in public institutions.

Factory Farming

Factory Farming and Industrial Production

Framing of industrial raising of animals for food production (not covering farming of plants).

Keywords: factory farming, industrial farming, intensive animal production, large-scale livestock, CAFO, industrial agriculture, mass production, industrijska farma, exploitation of animals

Examples: We oppose factory farming and its impact on animal welfare.; Ban on intensive animal production systems.

Anti-Hunting

Anti-Hunting and Snaring

Discourse opposing hunting, trapping, snaring, and other wildlife killing practices, including traditional and sport hunting.

Keywords: hunting, trapping, snaring, ban on hunting, wildlife killing, sport hunting, poaching, lov, caza, chasse, Fang, fällor

Examples: We call for a ban on trophy hunting.; End the use of snares and traps for wildlife.

Anti-Testing

Anti-Laboratory Experiments

Framing against animal testing, vivisection, laboratory experiments on animals, and the push for alternative testing methods.

Keywords: animal testing, vivisection, laboratory experiments, ban on animal testing, alternative methods, testing on animals, laboratorijska ispitivanja, experimentation animale

Examples: Ban on animal testing in laboratories.; Promote alternative methods to animal experimentation.

Gen. Welfare

General Animal Welfare

Broad statements about animal welfare standards, animal protection, and animal rights that do not fit specific frames above. ONLY assign when 'welfare' (or equivalent in other languages) is EXPLICITLY used.

Keywords: animal welfare, animal protection, animal rights, bien-être animal, Tierwohl, welzijn, bienestar animal, benessere animale, dobrobit životinja

Examples: We will improve animal welfare standards.; Animal welfare must be a priority in all policies.

🔗📁Die Pandemie führt uns viele der Fehlentwicklungen der Menschheit vor Augen: Massentierhaltung, Ausbeutung von Natur und Mensch, Umwelt- und Klimabelastungen, schlechte soziale Verhältnisse und zu enger Wohnraum haben der Pandemie zusätzlichen Nährstoff geboten und bleiben auch nach der Pandemie zentrale politische Herausforderungen. In Zentrum der Coronapandemie steht natürlich die Sorge um die Gesundheit der Menschen, insbesondere unserer älteren Mitbürger*innen. Aber viele Bürger*innen und Unternehmen haben auch schmerzliche finanzielle Einbußen gehabt und machen sich Sorgen um ihre Zukunft.
